findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 19 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 19.1.2 1, 19.2 1, 19.2.2 1, 19.3.2 1, 19.3.3 3, 19.4.1 1, 19.4.2 1, 19.5 2, 19.6 2, 19.7 1, 19.8 1, 19.8.1 3, 19.8.2 3.

Covers chromosome composition and levels of organization, genetic-material characteristics and Avery-MacLeod-McCarty, Griffith vs Hershey-Chase, Meselson-Stahl technique and pulse-chase, roles of replication enzymes, replication in prokaryotes vs eukaryotes, stability/variability and biotechnology uses, deciphering and characteristics of the genetic code, promoters and RNA polymerase, replication vs transcription, activation and ribosome sites, factors and enzymes of translation, levels of gene regulation and splicing, natural and induced mutations, silent/missense/nonsense mutations, treating genetic diseases, sickle cell vs PKU, chromosomal rearrangements, non-disjunction of sex chromosomes and autosomal trisomies. The exercise's long questions are not repeated. Book corrections followed (chromatid 700 nm; valine example of degeneracy; activators not said to bind the operator; trisomy pair 22).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
